==Description==
'''Unused Lobbies''' are lobbies which were planned to be used at one point, but ended up getting scrapped. These could be slight variations of lobbies that made it into the game, but also entirely new lobbies that were never implemented.

==Winter 2020 Lobby==
===Description===
'''Winter 2020 Lobby''' is the original lobby made for the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. It would contain a crate opening area, an armory, a store, a clothing store and a few [[Leaderboard]]s.

===Appearance===
'''Winter 2020 Lobby''' is located in a town during Winter. Players spawned in the middle of it, right above the crate opening area. Several buildings could be found in the lobby, with only 4 having an indoor area (one being locked behind a "''Coming Soon''" gate). A few [[Leaderboard]]s could be found as well. There are only three [[Elevators]] that can be seen in the lobby, which is likely due to them being mostly replaced by the [[Matchmaking]] elevator, accessed with the "''Play''" button.

==Unused Overhaul Lobbies==
===Description===
'''Unused Overhaul Lobbies''' refers to various older versions of the Overhaul Lobbies. The first notable lobby was very similar to the version that was added in [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] and later the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], though it had some notable differences it, while the next notable lobby would be similar to the [[Overhaul v1.1|Halloween 2020 Update]] lobby.

===Appearance===
The first notable '''Unused Overhaul Lobby''' is located in an outdoors area, surrounded by a portal on one side, various buildings on two sides and the sea on another. Players would spawn in the middle of the map, next to a [[Minigunner]] statue and directly above the inaccessible crate opening area. On one side, there is a red survival building, containing various [[Elevators]]. Directly next to it, it would lead to a statue holding up Earth, alongside pathways leading to [[Leaderboard]]s and [[MEGA Servers]]. The location of the [[Elevators]] and [[Leaderboard]]s changed between the versions. Next to it is a green building, which lead to either an underground section with more [[Elevators]], or to an upstairs spot which at one point contained [[PVP]] [[Elevators]]. Last notable side would have contained the teleport to the [[Hardcore Lobby]]. A few other spots existed, located somewhere around the four main areas, which include various statues or a pathway to the clothing area, which contained [[Clothing]] made by Tower Defense Simulator clothing designers.

The second notable '''Unused Overhaul Lobby''' is a Halloween themed version of the previous lobby. The lobby would be set during night with multiple pumpkins, a statue of the [[Dark Necromancer]], webs with spiders on them and a giant ghost ship.

==Mega Update Lobby==
===Description===
'''Mega Update Lobby''' is a lobby where players spawn in an outdoor area, where [[Leaderboard]]s and a few statues could be found. The [[Elevators]] in this map were located inside the buildings, split into a survival and [[Versus]] building, and an event and [[MEGA Servers]] building.

===Appearance===
'''Mega Update Lobby''' is located in a small outdoor area surrounded by multiple buildings on the sides. The outdoor area contains a stone path, a few trees, players [[Leaderboard]]s and multiple statues. While majority of buildings cannot be accessed, two of them are accessible by the players.

While the two accessible buildings have three floors, only parts of the first floor were accessible by the player. The rooms only contained a floor, one red other checkered, a few chandeliers, walls, benches and [[Elevators]]. They also had a few windows, which on some sides showcase areas that cannot be accessed by the player.

==Area 51 Lobby==
===Description===
'''Area 51 Lobby''' was a lobby made for the [[Area 51 Event]]. It ended up being unused due to BelowNatural believing that it was disorienting and misleading.

The lobby would have contained multiple [[Elevators]] that would lead the players into match and a [[Leaderboard]].

===Appearance===
'''Area 51 Lobby''' is a giant futuristic space ship made out of white metal and neon blue lights. On the sides, there would be [[Elevators]] that contain a window showing off the void and a board displaying the map it leads into. a [[Leaderboard]] would also be included.

==SFOTH Lobby==
===Description===
'''SFOTH Lobby''' is a lobby where players spawn in a small park surrounded by a large yellow building. While the building that surrounds the lobby is inaccessible, there is a portion of it underneath the roofs that can be accessed. This is where the players can use [[Elevators]], including [[MEGA Servers]] [[Elevators]].

===Appearance===
'''SFOTH Lobby''' a small park which contains a fountain in the middle, a few flowers and trees. This part is surrounded by a giant yellow building, which has a small accessible area under its roof. This area contains multiple [[Elevators]], including [[MEGA Servers]] [[Elevators]].

The building has decorated walls which also contain either small neon light or black windows. At the highest point of the walls, a giant sun can be seen. There is also a small path on top of the roof which has multiple trees growing on it.
